units.source_text: 次日，中将下山返京。

en.t: The next day, the Captain came down from the mountain and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 道经小野，他说：“不可过门不入。”

en.t: As his road passed through Ono, he said, "I cannot pass by the gate without going in."

units.source_text: 便又进草庵访问。

en.t: So he went into the thatched hermitage again to pay a visit.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧料得他要再来的，同女儿在世时一样地招待他。

en.t: The younger nun had expected that he would come again, and received him just as she had when her daughter was alive.

units.source_text: 奔走伺候的小尼僧少将君等，虽然换了服装，风韵仍是优美。

en.t: The young nuns who hurried about attending him, including Lady Shosho, had changed their dress, yet their grace remained beautiful.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧今天更是悲伤欲泣。

en.t: Today the younger nun seemed even more sorrowful, as though she were about to weep.

units.source_text: 谈话之中，中将乘便问道：“听说有一女子躲避在这里，究竟是谁？”

en.t: In the course of conversation, the Captain found an opening and asked, "I hear that a woman is hiding here. Who is she, really?"

units.source_text: 妹尼僧颇感为难，但念中将或已隐约窥见，

en.t: The younger nun felt quite troubled, but thought that the Captain might already have glimpsed something of the matter,

units.source_text: 瞒过他反而不好，便答道：“我时刻不忘亡女，

en.t: and that it would be worse to hide it from him, so she answered, "I never cease to remember my late daughter,

units.source_text: 深恐更增罪孽，因此最近抚养了这女子，聊以慰情。

en.t: and I deeply fear adding still more to my sins, so recently I have taken this young woman in, merely to comfort my heart a little.

units.source_text: 但此女不知有何伤心之事，一直愁眉不展。

en.t: But I do not know what grief this woman carries; she has remained constantly downcast.

units.source_text: 她深恐有人知道她还活在世间，

en.t: She is terribly afraid that someone might learn she is still alive in this world,

units.source_text: 所以躲藏在这谷底一般的地方，使外人无法找到。

en.t: and so she hides in this place like the bottom of a valley, where outsiders cannot find her.

units.source_text: 但不知你何由闻知此事？”

en.t: But I do not know how you came to hear of this."

units.source_text: 中将说道：“即使是怀着轻浮之心来访，也能以深山跋涉之劳为由而蒙原谅。

en.t: The Captain said, "Even if I had come here with a frivolous heart, I might be forgiven on account of the hardship of traveling through these deep mountains.

units.source_text: 何况我是将她比拟我的亡妻，岂可把我看作外人而远拒？

en.t: How much more so when I compare her to my late wife; how could you treat me as an outsider and keep me away?

units.source_text: 她究竟为了何事而厌弃人世？

en.t: For what reason, after all, has she come to loathe the world?

units.source_text: 我想安慰她一番呢。”

en.t: I would like to offer her some comfort."

units.source_text: 他表示愿得一见。

en.t: He expressed his wish to see her.

units.source_text: 临行时在便条上写了一首诗：

en.t: When he was about to leave, he wrote a poem on a note:
